content.short: Decentralized gaming ecosystem on Ethereum, Base, and Solana, powered by the PRIME token and shared infrastructure.
content.description:
Echelon Prime Foundation is a non-profit dedicated to building decentralized gaming infrastructure and a shared economy. Its central utility and governance token, PRIME, is used across multiple titles like Parallel TCG. Echelon provides developers with open-source smart contract libraries and token distribution frameworks to create competitive, high-fidelity Web3 experiences.

The ecosystem utilizes 'sinks' where PRIME is spent to unlock premium items, balancing the token economy. Governed by elected Emissary Primes, the foundation ensures the ecosystem remains decentralized. It bridges traditional gaming with Web3 through robust, shared infrastructure and community-driven development.
